Thanks — I ran preliminary checks on Karura. Summary:

- Sanctions screen: clean. No matches on major lists (OFAC, EU, UK).
- Export control note: SOW describes molecular assay optimization (not export-controlled hardware/software). Recommend a quick technical attestation from Karura that they will not route data to restricted jurisdictions.
- KYC: requested documents are standard; once provided we can complete corporate identity verification within 72 hours.

On the 60-day retention exception: Compliance/Legal will approve a pilot-only 60-day retention provided:
- The scope is strictly pilot telemetry (token-level telemetry and logs) and excludes billing and audit trails necessary for invoicing or fraud investigations.
- A sunset clause is added: exception expires at pilot end; standard retention resumes for any subsequent paid engagement.
- Karura signs an attestation that no controlled technical data (as defined under our export checklist) will be processed in the pilot.

If Deal Desk wants to proceed with 15% discount and the attestation above, I can sign off without Exec escalation. Anything >15% or a permanent retention policy change requires Exec approval (and a risk memo).
